blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Chito Victolero wanted to take a break from coaching after his stint with Magnolia in the PBA. But when Mapua came calling, Victolero couldn’t say no. “Actually, I wanted to rest. I wanted to rest for a year after my contract expired with Magnolia,” Victolero told Inquirer in an exclusive interview on Monday at San Juan Arena. “I wanted to recover and have a fresh start but Mapua came and I couldn’t say no to my alma mater.” READ: Chito Victolero, Jamike Jarin add firepower to NCAA coaching ranks “I’m really a Mapuan.
